oneLiner: It turns a child's dream into a learning path from real lessons it finds online, read aloud at the child's level.

pitch.who: parents and teachers of children aged 8 to 18
pitch.need: want each child to learn at their own level but have no time to find good content
pitch.benefit: turns a child's dream into a learning path it reads aloud
pitch.alternative: adults search the web at night and still can't tell what is right for the child's level
pitch.difference: the child names a dream and gets a tutor built from real lessons, each with its source

moment.text: Andy, 11, names his dream and watches the agent build his own tutor.
